summary: We have developed an interactive 3D space-survival game where kids step into the role of an astronaut completing daily tasks to survive on Mars across six progressive levels. Traditional science education often feels passive and disconnected from real-world space exploration, making it difficult for young learners to stay engaged. Our game addresses this challenge by turning space concepts into hands-on gameplay. At each hurdle, players must test their critical thinking by choosing among three possible solutions. Based on their decisions, dynamic popups appear in real time to deliver authentic scientific knowledge grounded in NASA facts. This approach is important because it bridges the gap between kids and real astronauts, transforming curiosity into active problem-solving. By combining immersive 3D exploration with instant, decision-driven learning, the game makes space science genuinely fun, accessible, and memorable for the next generation of explorers
details:
Our game transforms space education into an immersive survival experience. Players face different challenges and choose between three possible solutions. Based on their decisions, real-time popups provide scientific explanations and authentic NASA-based facts.

4. Key Features

Interactive 3D Mars environment.

Six progressive survival levels.

Three-choice decision-making challenges.

Real-time feedback and scientific explanations.

NASA-based educational facts.

Critical thinking and problem-solving gameplay.

5. Expected Outcomes

A functional 3D educational game that helps children understand Mars survival challenges, develop decision-making skills, and explore space science through interactive learning. Load emergency event in the game when NASA Space Weather Prediction Center sends a notification in real time.

6. Project Impact

Mars Survival bridges the gap between theoretical science and practical exploration, making space education fun, accessible, and memorable for the next generation of explorers.
